recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If Clinical Genomics wants a new graph for current molecular modeling, handle it as new MolecularDefinition or Molecular Definition IG work rather than as unfinished application of this DSTU2 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11016 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Clinical Genomics change request asking to add a sequence graph example to the genomics implementation guidance; its resolution said to update the sequence graph picture in the IG and create examples explaining the graph.
initial_application: Commit b2b49e7e2bb0572d2de4ba7516e2c44df48751b2 explicitly resolved #11016, updated source/genomics.html and its picture content, and added source/sequence/sequence-graphic-example-1.xml through sequence-graphic-example-5.xml with linked genomics images/examples.
additional_context: Current publish.ini still includes genomics.html, but that page is now a high-level Clinical Genomics landing page linking to Genomics Reporting, GenomicStudy, MolecularDefinition, and the Molecular Definition IG. source/fhir.ini comments out molecularsequence and actively lists moleculardefinition; source/sequence and source/molecularsequence are absent. Current MolecularDefinition guidance covers sequence representation and molecular representation methods with active examples/profiles.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the old graph or old sequence-graphic examples would revive obsolete Sequence/MolecularSequence content and would not be a correct current-core fix.
